message.content:
LeBron James is an American professional basketball player widely regarded as one of the greatest athletes in the history of the sport. Born on December 30, 1984, in Akron, Ohio, he rose to prominence as a high‑school phenom at St. Vincent‑St. Mary High School, where he was named the USA Today High School Player of the Year in 2003. He entered the NBA directly from high school, being selected first overall by the Cleveland Cavaliers in the 2003 draft.

James has played for the Cleveland Cavaliers (2003–2010, 2014–2018), the Miami Heat (2010–2014), and the Los Angeles Lakers (2018–present). He has won four NBA championships (2012, 2013, 2016, 2020), earned four NBA Most Valuable Player awards (2009, 2010, 2012, 2013), and has been selected to the NBA All‑Star Game 19 times (as of 2023). Known for his versatility, athleticism, and basketball IQ, LeBron has also made significant contributions off the court, including philanthropy, media ventures, and activism.
